task: Ask the app to help you stay ahead of the family calendar, and check what it says is coming up next and what is ready for it.
transcript: open: Home screen asked 'What can I help with?' with a text box, three example prompts, and the note that nothing is sent without my OK.
type + enter: I wrote 'help me stay ahead of the family calendar. what's coming up next and what do I need to have ready for it?' and it showed 'Getting started' then 'Sending'.
wait 30: a thread titled 'Upcoming family events and what to prepare' appeared, saying 'Your family calendar helper is on it', with Change and Details links and 'Working on it'.

wait 30: the answer arrived: next up is Rafi's soccer Sat Nov 14 9 to 10:30 at Riverside Park field 3 (bring cleats, water, shin guards), then Lincoln conference sign-ups Sun 7pm (book Mr. Brandt for Ezra's C+ and missing worksheets, then Mr. Ruiz, reminder at 6:45), Ezra's dentist Mon 3:30 with Dr. Shah (bring the new insurance card; science lab report due that day).

scroll down: the rest listed Ezra's emergency contact form Tue, Noa's piano recital Wed 6 to 7:30, Maple picture day Thu with the order form due that morning (reminder Wed 8:30pm), Hudson Prep application due Sun Nov 22 missing only my parent statement, and open enrollment closing Dec 1.
tap More: wanted to double-check against my calendar, but got a screen full of words like Workers, Board, Groups, Scheduler, a file path, 'chat', 'high' and 'claude-opus-5-5'. Confusing.
tap Calendar: a calendar opened in week view for Nov 8 to 14 with nothing on it.
tap Month: November 2026 month view, no events visible on any day, so I could not check the answer against it. Second confusing screen, so I stopped exploring.
tap '‹ Home': back to the chat thread with the answer still there.
stumbles: About a minute of 'Working on it' with three dots; fine, like ChatGPT thinking.
Tapping More (the only place that looked like it might show my calendar) opened a techy dashboard with Workers, Board, a file path and a model name.

The Calendar in that dashboard showed an empty November, so the events the helper listed were nowhere I could see. I could not check the answer against my own calendar, and it made me wonder where the helper got its information.
The answer is long; the 'what to have ready' items are mixed into each line rather than pulled out as a short checklist.
verdict: Asking was as easy as ChatGPT and the answer was genuinely useful: a dated, sensible run-down of the next week with what to bring and what was still missing, and dates that line up with today being Friday Nov 13. Trying to double-check it under More dropped me into a jargon-heavy dashboard whose calendar was empty, so I could not confirm the answer against my own calendar.
